boundaries: Per-file atomic installation is not a cross-file transaction or CAS against arbitrary external writers.
TypeScript native unversioned changes bind to pre-request synchronized snapshots; Rust still requires versioned documentChanges.
Browser origin restrictions are not Chrome whole-process network isolation; effective OS sandbox must be Off and non-Unix screenshots remain rejected.
Project model policy covers integrated Provider HTTP egress, not arbitrary plugins or external processes.
Detached verification journal does not mint Goal live evidence authority; restart requires revalidation.
Deterministic local fixtures do not measure real-model quality, billing, tokens or competitor performance.
Windows GNU cross lint is not Windows native execution or a release.
Manual TUI performance benchmarks, paid model/search runs, DAP, Computer Use/AX, voice, ACP, background precompression and /btw are outside this closeout.
